key.name: sidebar-on-right
key.description: When true the sidebar is placed on the right edge of the primary monitor. When false it is placed on the left edge.

key.name: sidebar-width
key.description: Width of the sidebar panel in pixels (48–400).

key.name: auto-hide
key.summary: Auto-hide when a window overlaps the sidebar
key.description: When enabled the sidebar fades out whenever any normal window on the active workspace intersects its screen area, and fades back in when the overlap is gone.

key.name: actions
key.summary: JSON array of sidebar action definitions
key.description: A JSON-serialised array of action objects. Each object has: type – action type identifier (string) label – button label text (string) icon – symbolic icon name (string) iconColor – CSS colour string, e.g. "#ff0000" (string) enabled – whether the button is shown (boolean) command – shell command for terminal-command / system-command appId – .desktop id for app-shortcut actions
